note: The SACRED VSL (video sales letter) page structure for the presentations upsell (GAUNTLET-LOOP DESIGN-OPUS §6.1-6.5, §10.3). Sections are checked IN ORDER. The email/phone gate is the structural heart: a Skill-44 form embed (never a static HTML mock) with email + first name + cell phone, ALL required, and an adaptive placement timestamp in the [3:00, 8:00] band (closer to 8:00, after the first big revelation). The prover MEASURES the declared HTML/video-metadata ledger and ignores any self-report.
gate_placement_rule: gate_time = clamp(R + 20s, 3*60, 8*60); if R unknown or D < 180s, default min(0.9*D, 480) but never below 180 and never above D-10s.

gate_fields.note: The gate form MUST collect all three, each REQUIRED. Custom GHL fields zhc_vsl_email / zhc_vsl_first_name / zhc_vsl_phone.

section_band_note: word_min is the SACRED per-section stripped-word floor (FIX-XC-04c pattern). The prover MEASURES stripped section copy and IGNORES any self-report; under-band = HARD MISS (AF-PRES-VSL-SECTION-BAND).
